B_star.no_eligible_budget: the budget rule FAILS; B* and N are not invented (exploration: candidate B* / N are null with the reason)
B_star.rule: the smallest N(B) x 3 x B among budgets where K1 holds and N(B) exists; ties to the smaller budget

K10.background_rule: 0 and Rng((seed ^ salt) & 0xffffffff).uniform(1 << 21), the first call

K2.ties: excluded from the sign test's n, kept in the resampled population

K3.denominators: mean(F - R) > 0 and mean(O - R) > 0 required; a non-positive denominator is not readable as satisfied

K5.n_scan: every integer from 8 to S, ascending, no bisection

K6.note: S is the number planned, never the number that completed

K7.prefix: arm O's first B* + 1 ledger records (base + B* search)

K8.replay: no finding on every executed run; a broken tool contract is invalid under section 9.1

K9.applicability_descriptive: (b) all-panel: section 9.3 clauses 4-5, recomputed from the same retained raw grids and reported beside (b')
K9.applicability_judged: (b') conditional: applicable_conditional = applicable_all_panel AND sr_mode = driven at both endpoints, for ff_srval and sr_kind; the five other semantics as the all-panel rule; the latch / x5FF exclusions kept
K9.median_population: all S seeds; one not-assessable seed makes the semantic's median not assessable
K9.panel: section 9.3: 32 mode combinations x INIT/SRVAL all-0 / all-1 = 64 backgrounds

anchor.rule: int.from_bytes(sha256(utf8(label + '|' + anchor))[:4], 'big'), the label passed beside the anchor

gonogo.applies_to: b4-sim-5 (protocol v0.3.0); b4-sim-4 was decided no-go under v0.2.0 and is not re-decided
gonogo.p_max_go_standing: an engineering cost threshold on the sign test's p, not the alpha of a formal scientific test
gonogo.precondition: every planned pair complete and valid, else no decision
gonogo.standing: an engineering cost policy for spending the gate's budget: not a significance result, not a gate, not an authorisation; no automatic successor
gonogo.statistic: one-sided exact sign test on Omega - R at B_go, ties excluded from n and counted; positives > negatives

thresholds_for_reference.standing: engineering research criteria fixed in advance; no number is claimed to be empirically guaranteed, statistically calibrated or valid for silicon; listed beside exploration values for reference only — never a gate verdict here

task.executing_side_input: PublicTask without the landscape seed, the planted genome or the private record (H: a fixed-program access contract, not information hiding)

stimulus.ce: slice-wide: one value per set step, high with probability 1/2 (uniform(2) == 0), broadcast as 0xFF / 0x00
stimulus.previous: task-v0.2: ce a per-element uniform 8-bit draw, sr each element with probability 1/4 (not realisable on one CE / SR pin per slice; consumed by b4-sim-4)
stimulus.sr: slice-wide: one value per set step, high with probability 1/4 (uniform(4) == 0), independent of ce, broadcast as 0xFF / 0x00

task.target: planted flip-flop configuration (T-i): storage_kind fixed to flip-flop, the other 20 bits drawn once by Rng((landscape_seed ^ 0x54415247) & 0xffffffff).uniform(1 << 20) onto the non-storage_kind bits in address order; the all-zero base included; nothing redrawn
